```json
 "rationale": "A 0.6 V common mode is too low for NMOS inputs, so both inputs are shifted up about 0.31 V by matched 2 uA sources into equal resistors; the shift cancels in the loop. Miller Cc makes the gate follow vout, which fixes undershoot near dVSG/k. The UGF sits near gm_p(light)/CL, giving >=40 dB PSRR at 1 kHz; Cff restores phase. A clamp driven by the OTA-diode current removes overshoot windup. Iq ~63 uA: IREF 10, tail 24, divider 20, shifts 4, bias 2, clamp 3."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> low Vgs, high gm1)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),
    "I_tail":  (24e-6, 14e-6, 28e-6),  # OTA tail = slew current
    "gmid_m":  (14.0, 8.0, 15.5),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id (low VSG -> M2 headroom at fs/-40)
    "L_m":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),
    "W_pass":  (4800.0, 2000.0, 5000.0),
    "L_pass":  (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
    "I_div":   (20e-6, 12e-6, 24e-6),  # current in R1 (also min pass current -> light-load gm_p)
    "v_shift": (0.31, 0.22, 0.40),     # input level shift (Is*Rs) above vref
    "r_ugf":   (1.0, 0.5, 1.4),        # UGF / light-load output pole
    "r_zff":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.5),        # Cff zero / light-load output pole
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    Is = 2e-6; Ip = 2e-6; It = p["I_tail"]; Ir1 = p["I_div"]
    # divider with shift current Is injected at tap: Vout = vref(1+R1/R2) - Is*R1
    R1 = (vt - vref) / Ir1
    R2 = vref / (Ir1 + Is)
    Rs = p["v_shift"] / Is
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)

    def vgs_for(lt, dev, W, L, Id, vds):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(48):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lt.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # ---- bias (all NMOS mirrors from ibias diode, same gm/Id & L)
    gb, Lb = 15.0, 1.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.55)
    mt  = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, It, vds=0.3)
    mbp = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ip, vds=0.6)
    I5 = 0.25 * It / 2.0          # clamp sense copy of OTA diode current
    I6 = 1.6 * I5                 # clamp threshold: M2 > 80% of tail
    m6  = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, I6, vds=0.1)
    gs, Ls = 12.0, 2.0
    mpd = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ip, vds=0.9)
    mps = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Is, vds=0.7)
    # ---- OTA
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I5, vds=0.8)

    # ---- pass device
    Wp, Lp = p["W_pass"], p["L_pass"]
    Ilight = imin + Ir1
    vsg_l = vgs_for(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, Ilight, 0.6)
    vsg_h = vgs_for(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, imax + Ir1, 0.6)
    opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_l, 0.6); oph = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_h, 0.6)
    gmpl = opl["gm"]; Cg = max(oph["cgg"], opl["cgg"])
    # worst-case headroom check (ss pfet cold, low VIN)
    try:
        vsg_ss = vgs_for(lut.at("ss", -40), "p", Wp, Lp, imax + Ir1, 0.42)
    except Exception:
        vsg_ss = vsg_h + 0.15
    vg_min_needed = 1.62 - vsg_ss

    # ---- compensation
    p2 = gmpl / (2 * PI * (CL + Cg))
    fu = p["r_ugf"] * p2
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Cc = gm1 * beta / (2 * PI * fu)
    Cff = 1.0 / (2 * PI * R1 * p["r_zff"] * p2)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MPS1", "g1", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)
    n.dev("MPS2", "g2", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)
    n.R("RS1", "g1", "vref", Rs)
    n.R("RS2", "g2", "tap", Rs)
    # OTA: fb (g2) on diode side so vg rises when vout rises
    n.dev("M1", "vg", "g1", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "g2", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vg", "d2", "vin", "vin", m3)
    # overshoot clamp (anti-windup / fast discharge)
    n.dev("M5", "y", "d2", "vin", "vin", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "y", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.M("MCL", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 8.0, 0.15)
    # pass + feedback
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vg", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "tap", R1)
    n.R("R2", "tap", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CC", "vg", "vout", Cc)
    n.C("CFF", "vout", "tap", Cff)

    # ---- predictions
    Go_l = opl["gds"] + 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    T = A1 * (gmpl / Go_l) * beta
    k = Cc / (Cc + Cg)
    dvsg = vsg_h - vsg_l
    assist = It * 200e-9 / (Cc + Cg)
    undershoot = max(dvsg / k - assist, 0.05)
    iq = iref + Ip + 2 * Is + It + I5 + Ir1
    vout_err = 100 * (1.0 / T + 0.002)
    load_reg = dvsg / (A1 * beta) / (imax - imin) + 0.05
    line_reg = 1.0 / T + 0.02 * Is * R1 / 0.36
    psrr = 20 * math.log10(fu / 1e3)
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": vout_err, "load_reg": load_reg, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq, "undershoot": undershoot, "overshoot": 0.15,
               "ripple_settled": 0.003,
               "_Cc": Cc, "_Cff": Cff, "_fu": fu, "_p2": p2, "_Cg": Cg,
               "_vg_min_needed": vg_min_needed}
```
